aiExplanation.summary: This Provider coordinates the Notes webview and keeps visible workflows bound to the selected Store and active resource.
aiExplanation.detail:
- postViewMode and setViewMode: Separate ordinary mode changes from toolbar-triggered resource loading.
- showResourceNotes: Opens an explicit file, directory, or Project Notes resource in Detail.
- showActiveResourceNotes: Rebinds both Detail and Navigator toolbar actions to the authoritative active editor and cursor line.
- loadResourceNotes and loadNavigatorNotes: Read scoped Detail and Navigator payloads while rejecting stale async results.
- Runtime State and relocation methods: Preserve Store identity while refreshing, confirming, and moving Notes.
